### 10 internal-error observations: unsafe name-list lookahead

`source/main.py:973-992`, especially line 991, computes `after_ok = after == len(value) or value[after].isspace()` for every unbraced `a`/`A`, **before** the next line tests `after <= len(value)`. The first corpus includes `Lam, Monica` (`fixtures/refs.bib:23`); the second includes `van Pol, Balthasar` (`fixtures/refs-edge.bib:25`). All four canonical styles scan author lists.
